description: Header file defining structures, constants, and function prototypes for HPACK header compression in lighttpd, including version info, header index enums, and encoding/decoding functions.

methods.name: lshpack_enc_init
methods.description: Initializes the HPACK encoder structure, allocating necessary memory.

methods.name: lshpack_enc_cleanup
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the HPACK encoder.

methods.name: lshpack_enc_encode
methods.description: Encodes a header name/value pair into the output buffer.

methods.name: lshpack_enc_set_max_capacity
methods.description: Sets the maximum capacity for the encoder's dynamic table.

methods.name: lshpack_enc_use_hist
methods.description: Enables or disables header history tracking.

methods.name: lshpack_enc_hist_used
methods.description: Checks if header history is currently used.

methods.name: lshpack_dec_cleanup
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the HPACK decoder.

methods.name: lshpack_dec_decode
methods.description: Decodes a header block into a header structure.

methods.name: lshpack_dec_set_max_capacity
methods.description: Sets the maximum capacity for the decoder's dynamic table.

methods.name: lshpack_enc_get_stx_tab_id
methods.description: Retrieves the static table ID for a given header.
